## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `status` line should be fixed to show the same 12-character revision as `history` and `completed`, because its docstring promises the same identifier and the code truncates to 7 characters.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py` to render a "Running" line with the revision and attempt number, plus an unused `REVIEW_HINT` string constant. It adds two tests for the new functions in `tests/test_display.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the 12-character revision in `status` — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` shows `0123456` while `history` shows `0123456789ab`. The docstring at line 13 says "using the same identifier as history", but line 14 slices `revision[:7]` and `history` slices `revision[:12]` at line 5. — Operators cannot match a running deployment's status line to its history or completion line by the displayed identifier. — Fix: Slice `revision[:12]` and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt`, whose `startswith` and `endswith` assertions do not check the revision.
